| Theme                                           | Topics & Concepts                                                                                                              | Common Exam Tasks                                                                         |
| :---------------------------------------------- | :----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | :---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| 🧠 **1. Bayesian Thinking & Model Workflow**    | Bayesian steps, priors / posterior / likelihood, DAG reasoning, prior + posterior predictive checks                            | *“List and explain steps in Bayesian data analysis with focus on causal analysis”*        |
| ⚖️ **2. Overfitting & Model Evaluation**        | Regularizing priors (防止模型过度拟合的先验), information criteria (AIC / WAIC / LOO / PSIS-LOO), pooling types (complete / no / partial) | *“Name and explain three principled ways of avoiding overfitting”*                        |
| 🔗 **3. Validity & Study Design**               | Experiments vs observational studies, internal / external / construct / conclusion validity                                    | *“Discuss the tension in validity threats between experiments and observational studies”* |
| 🔄 **4. Information Theory & Model Comparison** | Entropy 信息熵, K-L divergence (KL散度), information criteria linkage                                                               | *“Compute or interpret entropy/KL divergence; explain predictive accuracy”*               |
| 🧩 **5. Generalized Linear Models (GLMs)**      | Binomial / Poisson / Exponential / Gamma – their max-entropy justification + link functions                                    | *“Explain why we use the logit / log link for Binomial / Poisson models”*                 |
| 🧬 **6. Interactions & Chains / MCMC**          | Interaction effects, DAG paths, Metropolis & Hamiltonian MC, diagnostics (n_eff, Rhat, divergent transitions)                  | *“Explain how MCMC works and what diagnostics ensure reliability”*                        |
| 🧱 **7. Multilevel & Partial Pooling**          | Varying intercepts / slopes, hyperparameters & hyperpriors, shrinkage (收缩)                                                     | *“Compare complete, no, and partial pooling; why partial is best”*                        |
| 📈 **8. Mixture & Zero-Inflated Models**        | Over-dispersion (过度离散), Beta-Binomial, Gamma-Poisson (Neg-Binomial), Zero-Inflated variants                                    | *“When to use mixture / ZI models and how they differ from Poisson”*                      |
| 🧮 **9. Covariance & Gaussian Processes**       | Modeling correlations between varying effects, covariance matrix Σ and LKJ prior                                               | *“Explain what Σ and LKJ(η) represent in multilevel modeling”*                            |
